items.source:
The throwable is dispatched back into Spring MVC, and passed to
its exception handling mechanism. Since the response has
been committed by this point, the response status can not change.
items.translation: 该异常被重新分发回 Spring MVC，并传递给其异常处理机制。由于此时响应已提交，响应状态码无法更改。

items.source: Sends the buffered content as a server-sent event, without data. Only the events and comments will be sent.
items.translation: 将缓冲的内容作为服务器发送事件发送，但不包含数据。仅会发送events和comments。

items.source: Add an SSE "data" line for the given object and sends the built server-sent event to the client. Strings will be sent as UTF-8 encoded bytes, and other objects will be converted into JSON using message converters.
items.translation: 为给定对象添加一条 SSE "data" 行，并将构建好的服务器发送事件发送给客户端。字符串将以 UTF-8 编码字节形式发送，而其他对象将使用消息转换器转换为 JSON。
